text: dsh-plugin-store 是面向 DSH web 客户端的插件商店，在设置页提供可搜索和筛选的插件目录。它通过 DSH bundle 注册 host 服务，并由客户端展示分类、排序和分页列表；用户可手动刷新目录、设置自动刷新周期，并对目录插件执行安装或卸载。数据来自 dsh.do、awesome-dsh-plugin.com 和 GitHub topic 搜索，适合想在 DSH 网页中发现和管理插件的用户。GitHub API token 可选。

dsh-plugin-store adds a searchable plugin catalog to DSH web Settings. Its bundle registers a host service, and the client shows categorized listings with refresh and install or uninstall actions. It reads from dsh.do, awesome-dsh-plugin.com, and GitHub; a GitHub API token is optional.
想在 DSH 网页设置里搜索和浏览可用插件。
怎样从 DSH 的插件目录筛选并安装一个插件？
How can I browse and install plugins from DSH web settings?
dsh-plugin-store 的功能「浏览插件目录」：在 DSH 网页设置中展示由目录探测得到的插件，可按搜索词、分类和排序查看结果。客户端通过 pluginStore 获取目录状态并渲染列表。
dsh-plugin-store 的功能「刷新与管理插件」：用户可手动刷新或设定自动刷新间隔，并从目录项触发安装、卸载操作；host 侧提供对应远程方法。

dsh-plugin-store README · dsh-plugin-store · Plugin Radar：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An **App-Store-style plugin radar** for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It installs as a normal dsh bundle and adds a **「Plugin Radar」** entry to the web Settings page.

dsh-plugin-store README · dsh-plugin-store · Plugin Radar：- Probes plugins using the **same methods the radar/marketplace implementations actually use**, not README scraping:
  - `https://dsh.do/api/packages` — official dsh.do catalog API, paginated full catalog (4419+ packages).
  - `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` — curated registry (1247+ entries with categories, bilingual descriptions, install commands).
  - GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin` — both `sort=stars` and `sort=updated` slices.
- Browse plugins by **stars / practicality score / category / search / recency**.
- **Manual or automatic refresh** every 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes.
- Source-aware one-click **install / uninstall**: npm install commands from the catalog are preferred over GitHub source URLs (e.g. **modlens** installs from npm), with GitHub as the fallback; copy commands include the current profile.
- Proper DSH **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so it also shows up in the native Plugins page after installation.
- Avatar preloading + caching to avoid icon flicker.

dsh-plugin-store README · Why this over similar plugin radars / marketplaces?：| Area | Typical radar / marketplace | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data source | Scrapes README links, or only one GitHub search page, or only pushes a card stream | Uses dsh.do official catalog API + curated registry JSON + stars/updated GitHub search slices, the same data paths the original implementations use |
| Coverage | Often truncated at 1000 repos or a single topic page | dsh.do full catalog pagination (4419+) merged with curated registry and GitHub slices |
| Ranking | Usually star-only or update-only | Transparent **practicality score** (stars, description quality, topic, curated status, recency, homepage/language) + star/update/name sorting |
| UX | Floating card streams, chat-skill flows, or bare tables | Native Settings page with hero, category chips, search, sort, pagination, and install/uninstall buttons |
| Install type | Some are skills, some require manual `cordis.patch.yml` edits | A real `dsh.bundle` package: `dsh plugin add` mounts it into the profile plugin tree |
| Refresh | Fixed interval or manual only | User-selectable manual / 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 min, persisted across re

text:
dsh-plugin-store README · Install：> Note: the npm package name `dsh-plugin-store` may already be taken. Rename `name` in `package.json` and the id in `lib/client.js` before publishing.

```bash
dsh-plugin-store README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-store

dsh-plugin-store README · or from git：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/<your-name>/dsh-plugin-store.git
```

Then restart / refresh the dsh web UI. Open Settings and you should see **Plugin Radar**.

dsh-plugin-store README · How install targets are chosen：The radar no longer installs every plugin from its GitHub URL. For each probed plugin the host resolves a preferred install spec in this order:

dsh-plugin-store README · How install targets are chosen：| Priority | Source | Example | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `installCommandNpm` from dsh.do | `@liustack/modlens` | Preferred: published npm packages include their `dist` files and work out of the box. |
| 2 | `installCommandGit` from dsh.do | `https://github.com/owner/repo.git` | Used when no npm command is available. |
| 3 | curated `install` from awesome-dsh-plugin | npm or git spec | Community-curated command. |
| 4 | GitHub URL fallback | `https://github.com/owner/repo.git` | Used only when the data provides no install command. |

dsh-plugin-store README · How install targets are chosen：Each card shows an install-source badge (`npm install` / `git install` / `GitHub install`), and both the install button and the copy button use the same resolved spec. For example, **modlens** is installed as `dsh plugin --profile web add @liustack/modlens`, not from its GitHub source repository.

dsh-plugin-store README · Local test without publishing：```bash
./scripts/test-local.sh 34129
```

This copies the plugin into a throwaway `DSH_HOME` and starts a separate `dsh web` on the given port.

dsh-plugin-store README · Data sources：| Source | Description | GitHub token |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `github-topic:stars` | GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin`, sorted by stars | optional |
| `github-topic:updated` | GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin`, sorted by recently updated | optional |
| `dsh.do` | Official catalog API `https://dsh.do/api/packages`, paginated | none |
| `curated:awesome-dsh-plugin` | Curated registry `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` | none |
dsh-plugin-store README · Data sources：Set `DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` to raise GitHub API limits. `DSH_GITHUB_API` overrides the API base.

dsh-plugin-store README · Submit this plugin to the dsh ecosystem：1. **Add the `dsh-plugin` topic to the GitHub repository** — this is the key step and the officially recommended way. The official and third-party plugin markets will then discover the repo automatically.
2. **Optional: submit to the community curated list**
   - Fork the `awesome-deepseek-harness` repository.
   - Add this plugin to both `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` in the format required by that repo.
   - Open a Pull Request.
   - Note: the official main repository currently does not accept external PRs (`CONTRIBUTING.md` states this). The correct way to build the DSH plugin ecosystem today is **topic tagging + community curation**.
3. Best practice: ship the plugin first, tag it with `dsh-plugin`, then submit it to the community list for extra visibility.

dsh-plugin-store README · dsh-plugin-store · 插件雷达：[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 **App Store 风格插件雷达**。它作为一个标准 dsh bundle 安装，并在 Web 设置页新增「插件雷达」入口。

dsh-plugin-store README · dsh-plugin-store · 插件雷达：- 探针插件的方式来自**同类雷达/市场插件的真实实现**，而不是抓 README 链接：
  - `https://dsh.do/api/packages` — dsh.do 官方目录 API，分页拉取全量目录（4419+）。
  - `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` — 精选注册表（1247+，带分类、中英描述、安装命令）。
  - GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin` — 同时拉取 `sort=stars` 与 `sort=updated` 两个切片。
- 按 **star 数 / 实用度 / 分类 / 搜索 / 最近更新** 浏览。
- 支持 **手动刷新或每 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟自动刷新**。
- 一键 **安装 / 卸载** 会按数据源选择安装目标：优先使用目录中的 npm 安装命令（例如 **modlens** 用 npm 安装），GitHub URL 仅作兜底；复制命令自动带上当前 profile。
- 是真正的 DSH **bundle 插件**（`dsh.bundle.patch`），安装后也会出现在原生「插件」页面里。
- 头像预加载 + 缓存，避免图标闪烁。

dsh-plugin-store README · 相比同类插件雷达/市场的优势：| 维度 | 常见雷达 / 市场 | 本插件 | | --- | --- | --- | | 数据来源 | 抓 README 链接、只查一页 GitHub 搜索，或只推卡片流 | 使用 dsh.do 官方目录 API + 精选注册表 JSON + GitHub stars/updated 双切片，与原实现同源 | | 覆盖率 | 常见截断在 1000 个仓库或单页 topic | dsh.do 全量分页（4419+），合并精选注册表与 GitHub 切片 | | 排序 | 通常只按 star 或只按更新时间 | 透明的**实用度评分**（star、描述完整度、topic、精选收录、更新时间、主页/语言）+ star/更新时间/名称排序 | | 体验 | 悬浮卡片流、chat-skill 流程或裸表格 | 原生设置页：Hero、分类 chips、搜索、排序、分页、安装/卸载按钮 | | 安装形态 | 有些是 skill，有些要手改 `cordis.patch.yml` | 真正 `dsh.bundle` 包：`dsh plugin add` 即挂载进 profile 插件树 | | 刷新 | 固定间隔或仅手动 | 用户可选手动 / 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟，并持久化 | | 图标 | 原始 `` 列表容易闪烁 | 头像预加载 + 缓存 + 占位兜底 | | 本地测试 | 通常要先发布 | `scripts/test-local.sh` 不发布即可起临时 dsh web 测试 |

text:
dsh-plugin-store README · 安装：> 注意：`dsh-plugin-store` 这个 npm 包名可能已被占用。发布前请修改 `package.json` 的 `name`，并同步修改 `lib/client.js` 顶部 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-plugin-store" })` 中的 id。

```bash
dsh-plugin-store README · 从 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-store

dsh-plugin-store README · 或从 Git：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/<your-name>/dsh-plugin-store.git
```

然后重启/刷新 dsh Web 界面，打开「设置」即可看到「插件雷达」。

dsh-plugin-store README · 安装目标如何选择：插件雷达不再对每个插件一律使用 GitHub URL 安装。宿主侧会按以下优先级解析每个插件的首选安装目标：

| 优先级 | 来源 | 示例 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | dsh.do 的 `installCommandNpm` | `@liustack/modlens` | 最优先：npm 包自带 `dist` 产物，开箱即用。 |
| 2 | dsh.do 的 `installCommandGit` | `https://github.com/owner/repo.git` | 无 npm 命令时使用。 |
| 3 | awesome-dsh-plugin 的 `install` | npm 或 git 规格 | 社区精选命令。 |
| 4 | GitHub URL 兜底 | `https://github.com/owner/repo.git` | 数据源没有安装命令时才使用。 |
dsh-plugin-store README · 安装目标如何选择：每张卡片会显示安装方式徽标（`npm 安装` / `git 安装` / `GitHub 安装`），安装按钮与复制命令使用同一个解析结果。例如 **modlens** 会安装 `dsh plugin --profile web add @liustack/modlens`，而不是从 GitHub 源码仓库安装。

dsh-plugin-store README · 不发布本地测试：```bash
./scripts/test-local.sh 34129
```

该脚本会把插件复制到一次性 `DSH_HOME`，并在指定端口启动独立 `dsh web`。

dsh-plugin-store README · 数据源：| 来源 | 说明 | GitHub Token |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `github-topic:stars` | GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin`，按 star 排序 | 可选 |
| `github-topic:updated` | GitHub Search `topic:dsh-plugin`，按最近更新排序 | 可选 |
| `dsh.do` | 官方目录 API `https://dsh.do/api/packages`，分页全量 | 无 |
| `curated:awesome-dsh-plugin` | 精选注册表 `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` | 无 |

设置 `DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` 可提高 GitHub API 配额；`DSH_GITHUB_API` 可覆盖 API 地址。

dsh-plugin-store README · 提交插件到 dsh 生态的步骤：1. **给仓库打上 `dsh-plugin` topic**——这是最关键的一步，也是官方推荐的方式。官方及第三方插件市场会自动发现和收录该仓库。
2. **（可选）提交到社区精选列表**
   - 复刻（Fork）`awesome-deepseek-harness` 仓库。
   - 在 `README.md` 与 `README.zh-CN.md` 中按格式添加本插件信息。
   - 提交 Pull Request（PR）。
   - 注意：官方主仓库暂不接受外部 PR，`CONTRIBUTING.md` 中明确指出无法接受外部 Pull Request。
3. 最佳实践：先做出来并打上 `dsh-plugin` 标签，再提交社区精选列表以增加曝光。
